title: 第1章 尊道中的青年第2章 周岐
lines: 空庭，不存在于过去跟未来的时空节点，此刻九颗星辰般大小的球体悬挂在空庭中央
每一个球体都散发着不同的光芒，分别是白、金、青、蓝、紫、红、灰、橙、黑
一道惊天巨响，第三枚青色巨球正在坍缩碎裂
“三尊道失败了，这是第几次了？”
一道声音不知在空庭何处响起，空荡荡的回音，不知传向了何处
“这个纪元是第十一次了”
突然另一道声音响起，回应了刚才声音，话音刚落，第一个白色的巨球也震动起来
不同于刚才，巨球似乎是在蜕皮，落下一层层碎片，里面露出了一个婴儿，浑身上下洁白如玉，头上刻有一个至白的“一"字，形成强烈的冲击感
“是一尊道，快掩盖一下”
刚才话还没说完的第二道声音变急促了一些，随即只见一张巨掌将整个还未褪完的白球握住然后消失不见
随后一声巨响传来，第九个黑色巨球突然完全碎裂开
“哎，九尊道又碎了，几个纪元了都没有诞生出来，是不是哪里出问题了”之前第一道声音的主人再次响起在空庭
“只剩我们这边了，应该等不了多久了，得尽快送出去，不然……”
话未说完，突然剩下的球体都开始晃动
“怎么回事？”
话音说完，球体面前出现一位身穿黑袍的中年人，此人面容沧桑，左脸颊上刻有一个金色的“二”，接着黑衣男子身旁出现一名老者，也是身穿黑袍
不同于中年男子，老者身上浑身充满着一股玄妙的气息，双目竟是全白，似乎是个瞎子，但是仔细一看双目中竟是刻有白色的“一”字
“是纪元天道么…”黑袍老者眉头紧皱，中年男子也是面露一惊随即说道:
“大人不是说……”
“可能出事了，我先出去看看，你在这里守着”
说罢老者消失不见，就在中年男子沉思的时候，第七颗灰色的巨球也在褪开，男子突然一怔，随即震惊的自言自语道“怎么可能，七尊道，不是已经……”
还未等他说完，灰色巨球发出耀眼的灰色光芒，映盖了整个空庭
就在灰色光芒亮起的一刻，刚出界外的老人也回过头，随即一脸不可思议
“怎么可能，这是七……”老者话音未完，一道冲天光河向他这里冲来，光河所过之处皆化为粉碎静止不动
“归墟烬主…”
老者如临大敌，目光死死的盯着这条长河声音嘶哑道，只见长河之上出现一道人影，只是这道人影只是一团光影组成，没有颜色跟躯体
空庭界中
灰色光芒慢慢消失不见，随即刚才第七个巨球的位置，多了一道人影，一个身穿灰袍，似十七八岁的青年站在空中
青年相貌平平，但是浑身散发着一股神秘的气息，随即他睁开双眼，一双深邃的漆黑眼眸像是一团深渊让人深陷其中
刚才的中年男子也是望了过去，一下子呆在了原地
“怎么这么大？！”
男子刚说完，青年向他望去，突然男子双目无神，就这样静在原地不动
“轨迹出了一点问题么”
青年望着男子轻喃道，随即望向剩余的球体，思索片刻又望向了界外，准确的是望向界外长河上的光影
“还不到时候，还差一些”青年说完手腕上似乎亮了一下，随即口吐一字
content_en:
The empty court does not exist in the time and space node between the past and the future. At this moment, nine spheres the size of stars hang in the center of the empty court.
Each sphere emits a different light, which are white, gold, cyan, blue, purple, red, gray, orange, and black.
"Bang"
There was a loud noise, and the third giant blue ball was collapsing and shattering.
"How many times has this failed?"
A voice sounded from somewhere in the empty courtyard, and the empty echo spread to nowhere.
"This era is the eleventh."
Suddenly another voice sounded, responding to the previous voice. As soon as the voice fell, the first giant white ball also vibrated.
Different from just now, the giant ball seemed to be shedding its skin, and layers of fragments fell down, revealing a baby inside, as white as jade, with a white "一" carved on its head, creating a strong sense of impact.
"It's a Taoist, cover it up quickly"
The second voice that had not yet finished speaking became a little more urgent, and then a giant palm was seen holding the entire unfinished white ball and then disappeared.
"Bang"
Then there was a loud noise, and the ninth giant black ball suddenly shattered completely.
"Hey, Jiuzundao has been broken again. It has not been born for several epochs. Is there something wrong?" The owner of the first voice sounded again in the empty court.
"We are the only ones left. We can't wait long. We have to send them out as soon as possible, otherwise..."
Before he finished speaking, the remaining spheres suddenly began to shake.
"What's going on?"
After finishing speaking, a middle-aged man in black robe appeared in front of the sphere. This man had a vicissitudes of life and had a golden "two" engraved on his left cheek. Then an old man in black robe appeared next to the man in black.
Different from the middle-aged man, the old man's whole body is filled with a mysterious aura. His eyes are completely white, and he seems to be blind. However, if you look closely, there is actually a white word "一" engraved in his eyes.
"Is it the Heavenly Way of the Era..." The old man in black robe frowned, and the middle-aged man also looked surprised and said:
"My lord, didn't you say..."
"Something may have happened. I'll go out and take a look first. You can stay here and watch."
After saying that, the old man disappeared. Just as the middle-aged man was meditating, the seventh giant gray ball was also fading away. The man was suddenly startled, and then said to himself in shock, "How is it possible, Qizundao, isn't it already..."
Before he could finish speaking, the giant gray ball emitted a dazzling gray light, covering the entire empty courtyard.
The moment the gray light came on, the old man who had just stepped out of the boundary also turned around, and then he looked incredulous.
"How is it possible? This is seven..." Before the old man could finish his words, a river of light rushed towards him. Everything that the river of light passed through was shattered into pieces and stood still.
"The Lord of Return to Ruins..."
The old man stared at the long river as if facing a formidable enemy and said in a hoarse voice. He saw a figure appearing on the long river, but this figure was just a ball of light and shadow, without color or body.
In the empty garden
The gray light slowly disappeared, and then a figure appeared where the seventh giant ball had been. A young man in gray robes, who looked like he was seventeen or eighteen years old, was standing in the air.
The young man had an ordinary appearance, but he exuded a mysterious aura. Then he opened his eyes, and a pair of deep black eyes were like an abyss that made people sink into it.
The middle-aged man just now also looked over and stayed in place for a while.
"Why is it so big?!"
As soon as the man finished speaking, the young man looked towards him. Suddenly, the man's eyes were blank and he just stood still.
"Is there something wrong with the trajectory?"
The young man looked at the man and murmured softly, then looked at the remaining spheres, thought for a moment and then looked outside the boundary. To be precise, he looked at the light and shadow on the long river outside the boundary.
"It's not time yet, it's still a little short of time." After the young man said it, his wrist seemed to light up, and then he uttered one word.
title_en: Chapter 1 A Young Man Who Respects the Tao Chapter 2 Zhou Qi
